'''Blitzcrash Blightshade''' is an [[Alpha enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of Blitzcrash. The beast was once raised at Tanjian Hall and used to be Li Zhiyan's best friend. Its blightshade, however, retains nothing but its instincts for aggression.}}
